# Server Status Announcements

When the alpha environment wobbles, use these to communicate. The goal is to
lower anxiety, frame downtime as expected alpha wobble (not a crisis), and remind
players we're on it. Convention: **server down / known / ETA-or-no-ETA.**

### Variant A — known issue, working on it, no ETA

```text
Hey folks — the server is having a wobble right now. We see it, we're on it, but
we don't have an exact ETA yet. This is the kind of bump we expect during alpha.
Hang tight, take a breather, and we'll post updates right here the moment we know
more.
```
_Post it: pin in the community Discord status/announcements channel._

### Variant B — known issue, ETA provided

```text
Hey folks — the server is down for a bit of alpha maintenance. We know what's up
and expect to be back around <time / timezone>. Thanks for your patience while we
make things a little smoother behind the scenes. Updates will land right here.
```
_Post it: pin in the community Discord status/announcements channel._
